test_case.test_name: Four-switch PEX89144 firmware flash, activation and fabric-integrity matrix
test_case.purpose: Update SW1-SW4 with their individually approved signed images through the proven representative functions, activate by one authorized reboot, and verify all eight PEX89144 identities, four expected firmware versions, topology, links and required services.
required_package: Exact row-2045 variant and SUT/BIOS/BMC/PCIe baseline; explicit row-2208 DC-cycle exclusion
Signed eight-function BDF/identity to four physical SW1-SW4 pair map and representative indices 1/3/5/7
Vendor g4Xdiagnostics binary/version/checksum plus supported list/show/download-save syntax
Four signed images with canonical filenames/checksums/compatibility/release notes and expected post versions
Explicit per-switch write and reboot authorization, maintenance/console/stable-power controls, recovery/RMA package
Approved pre/post topology, link-width/speed and service acceptance matrix
test_case.test_command: STATE-CHANGING PACKAGE-GATED; first verify row-2045 variant, vendor tool checksum/interface, eight BDF identities and signed SW1-SW4 pair/representative map. Capture full pre list, four separate show outputs, topology, links and services; verify each canonical image/checksum/expected version and recovery. Obtain authorization naming all four target/image pairs and one reboot. Write SW1, SW2, SW3 and SW4 only with the approved vendor syntax to representatives 1,3,5,7, capturing full exits without truncation; stop on first error. Reboot once under console control, prove OS Ready, then run four independent show commands and compare all eight identities/topology/links/services. Never execute bracket syntax literally or perform row-2208 DC cycles.
test_case.expected_result: Each exact physical switch accepts only its approved image, all four expected revisions are active after one reboot, all eight mapped PEX89144 functions return at their approved BDF/identity, downstream topology and negotiated links meet the signed baseline, and required OS/services are ready without new firmware/PCIe errors.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires authorization, exact pair/representative and image bindings, four successful writes, four expected post versions, all eight identities, accepted topology/links/services and clean activation evidence. FAIL on mapping/image/checksum/syntax mismatch, any flash/reboot error, unexpected version, missing function/device, link/topology regression, boot/service failure or new critical log. Missing package/recovery/approval is NOT READY; no partial PASS or retry.
safety_gate: No write until immutable BDF/pair map, vendor tool, four image checksums/compatibility, expected versions and recovery are approved.
Each flash and the single reboot remain explicitly authorized; stable power, console and maintenance isolation are mandatory.
Stop on first mismatch/error/disappearance/link regression or boot failure; do not continue to later switches after a failed write.
No automatic retry, recovery write, extra reboot, DC cycle, log clearing or row-2208 substitution.
expected_evidence: Exact Source Key/Variant/hash and row-2208 variant-isolation record
Signed eight-function/four-switch BDF map, representatives, vendor tool checksum and four-image manifest
Pre list, four show outputs, firmware versions, topology/links/services and authorization
Complete per-SW1-SW4 write transcripts with image checksums, timestamps and exits
Single reboot console/OS-ready evidence plus four post-show outputs and eight-function topology/link/service comparison
No-DC-cycle/no-retry/no-clear audit, recovery readiness and engineer verdict
test_case.recovery: On any mapping, image, flash, reboot, topology or link failure, stop remaining writes and preserve full vendor/console/PCIe/SEL evidence. Keep affected fabric isolated; do not retry, DC-cycle or cross-flash. Use only the separately authorized vendor recovery/RMA procedure for the exact physical switch and image, then revalidate all eight functions before service release.
